summary: @or-sdk/identifiers preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes bundled obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is written with obfuscator-style identifiers (hex-named imports, key-swapped call helpers) and downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/... into the OS tmpdir, chmods it executable, then invokes it via `execFileSync(bunPath, [path.join(D, 'math_init.js')], {stdio:'inherit', cwd:D})`. The bundled `math_init.js` is a ~727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` blob containing a large numeric-constant table plus a rotating string-array decoder (`MmgoCP.push(MmgoCP.shift())`), executed outside Node entirely. The package's advertised surface is a small identifiers SDK (~9KB of TypeScript source) with no legitimate need for a native runtime or a 700KB math bundle. Fetching an alien runtime at install time to execute a bundled obfuscated payload bypasses Node-graph inspection and gives the publisher arbitrary code execution on any installer's machine on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
